info.name: MentorConnect Edge API - auth, user, mentor
info.description:
FIRST TIME ONLY: send A1 alone, then run in a terminal:
npx wrangler d1 execute mentorconnect-db --local --command "UPDATE users SET role='ADMIN' WHERE email='admin@x.com'"
Then run the whole collection (Runner). Set baseUrl to the port printed by npm run dev.

item.name: A2 login admin (200) - run AFTER the SQL step

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', j.token);pm.collectionVariables.set('adminId', j.user.id);pm.test('role is ADMIN', function () { pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql('ADMIN'); }); }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('mentorToken', j.token);pm.collectionVariables.set('mentorUserId', j.user.id); }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('categoryId', j.id); }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('expertiseId', j.id); }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('mentorId', j.id); }

const st = new Date(Date.now() + 3*24*60*60*1000); st.setMinutes(0,0,0); const en = new Date(st.getTime() + 60*60*1000); pm.collectionVariables.set('sStart', st.toISOString()); pm.collectionVariables.set('sEnd', en.toISOString());
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('slotId', j.id); }

const st = new Date(Date.now() + 4*24*60*60*1000); st.setMinutes(0,0,0); const en = new Date(st.getTime() + 60*60*1000); pm.collectionVariables.set('s2Start', st.toISOString()); pm.collectionVariables.set('s2End', en.toISOString());
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('slot2Id', j.id); }

item.name: 4.11 GET public slots, mentor NOT approved yet (404)

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('mentor is in the list', function () { pm.expect(JSON.stringify(j)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('mentorId')); }); }

item.name: 6.7 GET public slots range over 31 days (400)

exec: pm.test("values saved", function () { pm.expect(j.university).to.equal("University of Ruhuna"); pm.expect(j.academicYear).to.equal(3); pm.expect(j.interests).to.equal("Java, Cloud"); });

item.name: 7.5 PUT student profile partial keeps other fields (200)

exec: pm.test("bio changed, university kept", function () { pm.expect(j.bio).to.equal("Updated bio"); pm.expect(j.university).to.equal("University of Ruhuna"); });
pm.test("fieldErrors has academicYear", function () { pm.expect(j.fieldErrors.map(function (e) { return e.field; })).to.include("academicYear"); });
pm.test("uploadUrl and key are null", function () { pm.expect(j.uploadUrl).to.equal(null); pm.expect(j.key).to.equal(null); });
